item.title: Psalm 23
item.description: "Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me."

item.title: To Move, or Not to Move?
item.description: As more Americans pull up stakes and move to states that align more closely with their political views, it's worth considering the consequences.

item.title: America's Military Men and Women More Faithful
